subject: SOC 2 gap walkthrough & artifact ask — next steps
messages:
From: Matthew Haldane <matthew.haldane@helionfin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helionfin.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 13:15:00 -0500
Subject: Follow-up from today's SOC 2 walk-through

Olga,

Thanks again for the call earlier — it was helpful to see how Redwood approaches runtime auditing and retention. A quick recap from our side so we have shared expectations:

- Primary pain points: lack of immutable audit log retention across regions, unclear proof of tamper-resistance, and limited visibility into token-level access for inquiry requests.
- Goals: confirm Redwood can meet a 7-year retention requirement for payment-related logs (with encryption in transit and at rest), show a mapping to SOC 2 CC controls for log integrity and monitoring, and get a sample of the logs + DPA language that aligns with our legal team's standards.
- Compliance asks we raised: SOC 2 control mapping, sample audit-log extracts (redacted), pen test summary/report, and a DPA redline we can review.

Could you confirm what artifacts you can provide and an expected delivery timeline? We need something to start our internal risk review by next Friday (12/17). Happy to do a quick follow-up call if that helps.

Thanks,
Matt Haldane
Head of Security
Helion Financial

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Matthew Haldane <matthew.haldane@helionfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's SOC 2 walk-through

On Wed, Dec 9, 2026 at 1:15 PM Matthew Haldane <matthew.haldane@helionfin.com> wrote:
> Olga,
>
> Thanks again for the call earlier — it was helpful to see how Redwood approaches runtime auditing and retention. A quick recap from our side so we have shared expectations:
>
> - Primary pain points: lack of immutable audit log retention across regions, unclear proof of tamper-resistance, and limited visibility into token-level access for inquiry requests.
> - Goals: confirm Redwood can meet a 7-year retention requirement for payment-related logs (with encryption in transit and at rest), show a mapping to SOC 2 CC controls for log integrity and monitoring, and get a sample of the logs + DPA language that aligns with our legal team's standards.
> - Compliance asks we raised: SOC 2 control mapping, sample audit-log extracts (redacted), pen test summary/report, and a DPA redline we can review.
>
> Could you confirm what artifacts you can provide and an expected delivery timeline? We need something to start our internal risk review by next Friday (12/17).

Thanks for the clear summary, Matt — appreciate the priorities. Below is what we committed to during the call plus a proposed schedule. If anything below needs to be shifted, let me know and we can adjust.

Deliverables (initial packet):
- Redwood-SOC2-Control-Mapping-v1.xlsx (controls -> runtime features + mitigations) [attached]
- sample-audit-log-snippet.txt (redacted, timestamps + hash headers to show integrity proof) [attached]
- DPA-redline-notes.pdf (high level redline + comments) [attached]
- Pen-test-summary.pdf (executive summary of most recent engagement) — will provide as a redacted summary if full report cannot be shared.

Timeline: 
- Within 3 business days (by Mon 12/13): deliver the initial packet (mapping + sample logs + DPA notes).
- Within 10 business days (by Thu 12/23): provide the fuller artifact bundle (pen test executive summary, retention configuration screenshots, and a short runbook for audit extraction).

Open questions we flagged that would change the ask:
1) Which legal entity / region should we scope the DPA and retention config for (US, EU, or multi-region)?
2) Do you need an immutable, long-term archival copy (cold storage) under Redwood Private, or is a hosted retention S3-backed solution acceptable with export proofs?

Next steps: I will ship the initial packet and mark items that contain redacted data. Ben will include an example extraction command and retention config screenshot. Soojin will add SOC 2 control crosswalk notes and the pen-test executive summary. Laura will summarize the DPA redlines for quick review.

If helpful, we can block 30 minutes on Friday to run through the artifacts together.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood-SOC2-Control-Mapping-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- sample-audit-log-snippet.txt (text/plain)
- DPA-redline-notes.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Internal — artifact owners & delivery plan (Helion)

Team — quick internal alignment so we hit Matthew's 12/17 ask and our internal EOD delivery cadence: 

- Soojin: own SOC 2 crosswalk (finish mapping, note any gaps we need to call out) + pen-test exec summary (redacted if necessary). Target: 12/13 EOD.
- Ben: produce the redacted audit-log snippet, include the hash header proof and an example extraction command + retention config screenshot (US region). Target: 12/13 EOD.
- Laura: DPA redline summary and a one-page note on data residency options & required contract language. Target: 12/14 EOD.
- Olga: review the package, do a final quality pass, and send to Helion by COB 12/14 (gives Helion time before their internal review on 12/17).

Risks/notes: If Helion requires full pen-test report, legal will need a public redaction plan — call that out early. If they demand multi-region immutable archives, we should tee up Redwood Private as a path (cost + timeline implications).

I'll draft a short delivery plan doc and attach it to the outbound email.

Thanks — O.

Attachment: artifact-delivery-plan.md (text/markdown)
